subject: gk
question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct option:

Assertion (A): In the Global Ease of Doing Business rankings, the highest weight was assigned to the ‘Starting a Business’ parameter.

Reason (R): ‘Starting a Business’ was one among the ten indicators used in the index.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4: A is false, but R is true**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Assertion (A):** The statement that the highest weight in the Global Ease of Doing Business rankings was assigned to the ‘Starting a Business’ parameter is **false**.
 
• The ‘Starting a Business’ indicator is indeed one of the ten parameters used in the Global Ease of Doing Business rankings, but it does not hold the highest weight among these indicators.
 
• **Reason (R):** The statement that ‘Starting a Business’ was one of the ten indicators used in the index is **true**.
 
• The ten indicators used in the Ease of Doing Business rankings include: Starting a Business, Getting Credit, Registering Property, Protecting Minority Investors, Paying Taxes, Trading Across Borders, Enforcing Contracts, Resolving Insolvency, Dealing with Construction Permits, and Getting Electricity.
 
• Among these, parameters like "Resolving Insolvency" and "Enforcing Contracts" have significant weightage due to their impact on the overall ease of doing business in a country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Ease of Doing Business Index:**

 
 
• It was an annual index published by the World Bank to measure the ease with which businesses can operate in different countries.
 
• The index ranked countries based on their performance in ten indicators, which highlight various aspects of regulatory frameworks that impact businesses.
 
• In the 2020 rankings (the last published), New Zealand ranked first, followed by Singapore and Hong Kong.
 
• India significantly improved its position in the index over the years, climbing to the 63rd rank in 2020, up from 142nd in 2014.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the ‘Starting a Business’ Indicator:**
 
 
• This indicator evaluates the number of procedures, time, cost, and minimum capital requirements involved in starting a business.
 
• It is a critical indicator for entrepreneurs, as it reflects the efficiency of the business environment in initiating operations.
 
• However, it is just one of the ten indicators, and the overall ranking depends on the combined performance across all indicators.
 
 
 
• **Other Key Indicators in the Index:**
 
 
• **Getting Credit:** Reflects the availability of credit and legal protections for borrowers and lenders.
 
• **Trading Across Borders:** Assesses the time and cost associated with the logistical process of exporting and importing goods.
 
• **Resolving Insolvency:** Measures the time, cost, and recovery rate of resolving insolvency situations, which is crucial for business sustainability.
